headline: Northern Fronts Flare as Linn of Mercy Sees Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: Linn of Mercy, which had quieted earlier, flared back into sharp contention over the past two hours with five strategic base transitions centered on Lathair alongside mounting casualties. Nevish Line and Weathered Expanse remain the primary cauldrons of combat; Nevish Line absorbed nearly nine hundred total casualties across the last two hours while logging six base exchanges around Princefal and Grief Mother, while Weathered Expanse recorded four fresh shifts near Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance. Kuura Strand likewise sustained steady tactical friction at Faden Point with three base movements in the recent two-hour frame. In contrast, Marban Hollow cooled markedly over the past two hours after substantial morning turnover at Checkpoint Bua, posting no new structural transfers. At the Dead Lands, fierce attrition persists with nearly seven hundred combined casualties in the last two hours despite lines holding firm without base flips. Deep southern heartlands and perimeter island sectors remain undisturbed under full Colonial administration.
